title: Turbo4DGen: Ultra-Fast Acceleration for 4D Generation
abstract: arXiv:2603.29572v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: 4D generation, or dynamic 3D content generation, integrates spatial, temporal, and view dimensions to model realistic dynamic scenes, playing a foundational role in advancing world models and physical AI. However, maintaining long-chain consistency across both frames and viewpoints through the unique spatio-camera-motion (SCM) attention mechanism introduces substantial computational and memory overhead, often leading to out-of-memory (OOM) failures and prohibitive generation times. To address these challenges, we propose Turbo4DGen, an ultra-fast acceleration framework for diffusion-based multi-view 4D content generation. Turbo4DGen introduces a spatiotemporal cache mechanism that persistently reuses intermediate attention across denoising steps, combined with dynamically semantic-aware attention pruning and an adaptive SCM chain bypass scheduler, to drastically reduce redundant SCM attention computation. translated_title: Turbo4DGen：面向4D生成的超快速加速框架
translated_abstract: 4D生成，即动态3D内容生成，融合了空间、时间和视角三个维度来建模逼真的动态场景，在推动世界模型和物理AI发展中发挥着基础性作用。然而，通过独特的空间-相机-运动（SCM）注意力机制在帧与视角之间维持长链条一致性，会带来巨大的计算和内存开销，常常导致内存溢出（OOM）失败以及令人难以接受的生成时长。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了Turbo4DGen，一个面向基于扩散模型的多视角4D内容生成的超快速加速框架。Turbo4DGen引入了一种时空缓存机制，可在去噪步骤间持续复用中间注意力结果，并结合动态语义感知注意力剪枝与自适应SCM链旁路调度器，大幅减少冗余的SCM注意力计算。我们的实验结果表明……
tldr: Turbo4DGen通过时空注意力缓存、语义感知注意力剪枝和自适应SCM链旁路调度三项技术，大幅降低冗余计算与内存开销，实现基于扩散模型的多视角4D内容生成的超快速加速。
en_tdlr: Turbo4DGen achieves ultra-fast diffusion-based multi-view 4D generation by combining spatiotemporal attention caching, dynamic semantic-aware attention pruning, and an adaptive SCM chain bypass scheduler to drastically cut redundant computation and memory overhead.
